initialize_template_manager: initialize chat and completion templates for a tokenizer manager with optional model path and template arguments
load_chat_template: load a chat template from a built-in name, Jinja file, or JSON file for a tokenizer manager
load_completion_template: load a code completion template by built-in name or JSON file path
load_jinja_template: load a Jinja template file and set it as the chat template on the tokenizer manager
load_json_chat_template: load a JSON chat template file and register it with the conversation registry
